art.bubble_en: Excuse me — the left side, please!
art.title: POV: your first escalator in Japan

gags: freeze snap inside a moving clip (commuters freeze staring at the hands on the right side, escalator and station keep moving)
WRONG WAY / RIGHT WAY verdict stamps (overlays on moving footage)
silence-to-shout (woman office worker, female voice: すみません、左ですよ！ / Excuse me — the left side, please!)
the wait (commuters stream past on the right while the POV rides up on the left)
punchline: one side walks, the other side waits.
pdca.hook: You stand on the right. The whole line stops.
